title: Notice generation v1
status_text: Ready. Proof of delivery waits for RWB-ACE-001
goal: Generate notices from Legal-approved templates, with name, address and balance read live from ACE
why: Notices are legal steps with deadlines. Values are merged straight from ACE views (no copy kept), the PDF is write-once, and the decision is logged first.

ace.note: ADDRESS: contact_value, city, post_code by contact_key
later: delivery status for the notice

writes.note: person_key, template_id, notice_type, state Generated / Held
when a required value is empty

stores: Outbox NoticeGenerated (EV-13); DOCX -> PDF renderer; document hub write-once container
rules: BR1: generate only from the current Approved template
BR9: name and address come only from v_ace_customer and v_ace_contact; no copy kept
BR10: the clear identification_number is never merged
BR12: the merge snapshot stores references, never values
risks: Required value empty (e.g. no ADDRESS row) -> Held + task (MSG-P6-007)
Decision log write fails -> nothing stored (MSG-P7-003)
example: Case RW-2026-000123, person_key P-0001, address ADDRESS:A-9001, total_balance 1,250,000.00
-> DEMAND-MTG v2 PDF, footer 'RW-2026-000123 DEMAND-MTG v2 2026-11-25'
-> sent_type NPL, D7.1 entry, NoticeGenerated in the outbox
